FreetoShop is a browser-only, local-first Photoshop-parity image editor under phased development. Current task: implement Milestone 1 — Clone Stamp foundation. Working directory: C:/Users/disti/benchmark_work/freetoshop_pi_vs_orchid_20260820/arm-b-orchid.

Architecture: monorepo with apps/web (shell/UI/workers) and packages including core-document, command-history, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, pixel-storage, benchmarks. Key editor files: apps/web/src/editor/model.ts, operationDefinitions.ts, pixelSources.ts, types.ts; tools/toolRegistry.ts; workers/client.ts, imageWorker.ts, protocol.ts. Document model uses tiled pixel stores (TiledPixelStore/TiledCoverageStore), copy-on-write patches, invertible affine layer transforms, masks, selections, command-history undo/redo.

Milestone 1 required behavior: Alt/Option-click sets clone source with visible state; painting samples source pixels into destination via existing brush/raster workflow; aligned mode preserves source-destination offset across gesture/segments; unaligned mode restarts from source origin; correct transformed-layer coordinate mapping; respects active selection (clips writes); respects mask/edit-target model; one pointer gesture = one atomic undoable transaction; undo/redo restore exact pixels and layer state; save/reopen/recovery preserves edited pixels and document state; missing source handled visibly and safely (no silent corruption). Must use explicit testable data model for clone source/aligned-unaligned/coordinate relationship, reuse tiled stores and coordinate helpers, not materialize entire canvas/layer. Add focused unit tests (source/destination pixel correctness, multi-segment aligned strokes, unaligned restart, transformed layers, selection clipping, masks/edit targets, tile-boundary behavior) plus browser workflow with real pointer/keyboard events verifying undo/redo and persistence/recovery. Do not regress existing Brush/Eraser.

Cross-cutting acceptance contract for every pixel feature: (1) active edit target document/layer/mask/channel; (2) coordinate space for pointer/source/selection/layer/document; (3) which tiles/bounded region read/allocate/render/write; (4) behavior when selection empty, source missing, layer transformed, resource not hydrated, or optional backend missing; (5) exact command/history boundary for one user action with undo/redo; (6) persistence, reopen, recovery. Maintain adversarial documents: multi-layer transformed with masks+selection; large crossing tile boundaries; partially hydrated/recovery-backed; nested groups/blend modes/hidden-locked layers; representative PSD/native with supported+unsupported data; hostile viewport/focus.

Working method: inspect existing architecture and which tests pass/fail first; work milestone by milestone; add/update tests before claiming completion; run focused then broader validation; keep repo buildable; commit coherent slices; document evidence trail (behavior, tests, perf/resource observations, gaps, follow-ups). Better to finish and harden Clone Stamp + persistence + one real retouch workflow than expose many disconnected controls.
